requiredFinalDemoVideo.title: Lost Sword full semantic compiler wow demo
narrativeBeats: Live gate verifies Lost Sword is foreground, playable, and not blocked by maintenance/auth/store/update screens.

Semantic compiler observes the current screen and expands a 3-4 level QA tree from lobby into battle, treasure, character, inventory/item, summon-entry, shop/paid guard, recovery, and edge-case branches.
Agent executes player-like actions from semantic targets, not raw coordinate labels, while the overlay shows only observation, selected intent, oracle, and result.
Battle path enters stage/combat/result surfaces and records domain events such as battle.entry, combat/result transition, reward/result-card evidence, or explicit terminal blockers.
Non-battle mutation path records at least one reward/character/item/free-summon mutation delta and then a duplicate/no-second-delta prevention check.
Recovery path intentionally handles hidden HUD, modal, loading, maintenance, or unknown scene transitions and shows the decision changing from evidence.
Final coverage matrix proves every generated eligible leaf was executed or terminal-blocked with reason; skipped work is never shown as PASS.
